notes: Only bundled graphical data and license statements ingested; no MakeHuman program logic
default.mhmat supplies no photographic skin texture; skin pack retrieval remains blocked
Rawsource retained verbatim; preprocessing is an engineering rebind/restpose study, not a finishedhuman

T-3465: an explicitly selected complete manifest for the child bodies, as SOURCE-female.json is for the female body: every row of SOURCE.json repeated unchanged, then the twelve child and baby macro targets (three upstream shape categories x two sexes x two ages), each fetched from the pinned commit on 2026-11-08 and carrying its own CC0 header. SOURCE.json and every existing preparation stay byte-identical.

The child and baby targets are MakeHuman graphical data; the ages they stand for (baby 1 year, child 10 years, young 25) are read from the same pinned commit, apps/human.py getAgeYears/setAgeYears (MIN_AGE 1, MID_AGE 25, child weight peaking at slider 0.1875 = 10 years). Only those three numbers are used; no program logic is copied.
